Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: March marketplace invoice - entity & VAT routing discrepancy

Hi Vivek / Laura,

We ran our month-end close and discovered an issue with the March marketplace invoice (Marketplace Invoice #M-202703-NEB). A subset of usage that should have been invoiced to Redwood EU (Redwood B.V.) was billed under Redwood US. That matters for our VAT treatment — Nebula needs the invoice allocated to an EU entity to reclaim VAT.

Attached is a usage export (nebula_march_usage.csv) and a short statement (redwood_statement_march.pdf) showing the lines in question (rows 42-67). Can you confirm:

- Whether Redwood can reissue a corrected invoice or provide a credit note that maps the charges to Redwood B.V.?
- If a credit note is preferable, will that include VAT breakdown at the EU rate?
- Estimated timeline — our AP cutoffs are 4/30, so we need this before then to avoid delaying payment.

Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Pierre Lamarche
Head of Finance, Nebula.ai
Attachments: nebula_march_usage.csv (CSV, 64KB), redwood_statement_march.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Pierre — thanks for the clear files, and for flagging the AP timing. Adding Marissa and Karthik to coordinate finance and marketplace metering.

Quick plan:
- Marissa: run a ledger-level reallocation and propose either a corrected invoice (if the marketplace partner supports entity reassignment) or a credit note + re-invoice to Redwood B.V.
- Karthik: confirm whether our marketplace metering records can produce an entity-split export (so we can match per-line).
- Laura / Finance: if we go credit-note route, we need finance approval for VAT reclassification and sign-off on the credit note language.

Can we target a draft credit note by 4/18 and final by 4/20? If Nebula can accept a DocuSign credit note, that will speed processing.

I'll review the CSV in parallel and call out any mismatches.

Thanks,

Hi Pierre / Vivek —

Thanks for the file. I pulled the marketplace metering export and matched the lines you highlighted. Summary below:

- Confirmed affected lines: 2027-03-05 to 2027-03-21, 26 line items, total EUR 18,240 (matches your calc).
- Root cause: partner metering attribute defaulted to "redwood_us" for some EU region traffic during a billing window change; partner exports did not include customer entity override.

Proposal (recommended):
1) Issue a credit note (CN-2027-04-NEB-01) for EUR 18,240 under Redwood US, with VAT breakdown.
2) Reissue an invoice (INV-2027-04-NEB-RE) billed from Redwood B.V. for the same net amount, showing VAT at the applicable EU rate.
3) Provide line-level mapping CSV and a short reconciliation memo (attached).

Operational notes:
- Timeline: Draft credit note & reissue files by 4/19 COB; final approvals and DocuSign by 4/20 morning.
- Finance impact: net revenue recognized timing unchanged; tax is a reclassification. Karthik, can you confirm any inter-entity accounting entries we should prepare?

Related links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cExampleDriveLink (draft credit note and mapping)

Attached: credit_note_draft.xlsx (draft lines and VAT calc).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations — Marketplaces
Redwood Inference
